secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Server-side secret used to sign login/session JWT tokens. A development value is auto-generated; override only if you want a specific one.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com → API keys). Enables the AI chat and the Crop Doctor photo diagnosis. Optional — the app runs without it.

secrets.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Tavily search API key (app.tavily.com). Enables live web research for the Crop Doctor. Optional.

secrets.name: PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack secret key (dashboard.paystack.com → Settings → API Keys). Enables real RWF mobile-money/card checkout. Optional — checkout runs as record-intent only without it.

secrets.name: PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack public key, paired with PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY. Optional.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth Web client ID (Google Cloud Console → Credentials). Enables 'Sign in with Google'. Optional.
